findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when the user has no TopicUser row.
findings.body: `TopicUser.find_by` returns nil when the user has no row for this topic. That happens when the user was notified by a mention or a group message without ever visiting the topic, or when a logged-in user opens a link someone forwarded to them. The next line, `tu.notification_level`, then raises NoMethodError and the request fails with a 500. Fix: use `TopicUser.change(...)` or `find_or_initialize_by`, and treat a nil level as regular.

findings.title: Shared `unsubscribe_link` string now requires `unsubscribe_url`, but only post notification emails pass it.
findings.body: `MessageBuilder#html_part` (and probably the text body) calls `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` for every email with `add_unsubscribe_link: true`. Only `UserNotifications#send_notification_email` now passes `unsubscribe_url`. Other senders that set `add_unsubscribe_link`, such as the digest email, will hit a missing interpolation argument. That either raises I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument or shows a broken link. They would also show a "this particular topic" line that makes no sense in a digest. The spec had to add `unsubscribe_url` to pass, which points to the same problem. Fix: use a separate key for the per-topic line, and add it only when `@template_args[:unsubscribe_url]` is present. I could not see the other callers to confirm which ones set `add_unsubscribe_link`.

findings.title: A GET request changes notification state with no CSRF protection.
findings.body: `unsubscribe` is routed as GET (config/routes.rb) and saves a new notification level on every request. GET requests skip CSRF checks, so any third-party page can embed `` and mute or downgrade topics for whoever is logged in. Mail link scanners that prefetch URLs can also unsubscribe users who never clicked. Repeat visits keep lowering the level (watching → regular → muted). Fix: make the GET only show a confirmation page, and do the change through a POST/PUT from the page, or protect the link with a per-user signed token.
